messages.author: ae8c6f7e9d5b4675
messages.subject: progress bar with shiny 0.11
parts:
Hi,

I developed an app with multiple Progress bars (succession of progress bars for a series of reactive functions) that worked fine with the previous version of shiny (0.10.2), It seems that, with the new version, there is a delay before the bar is visible in the web browser that makes it meaningless. I put some spies (cat() functions) in my lengthy functions to check that they were called, while the progress bars were not visible. 

I use 

withProgress(message = "My message", {
  setProgress(value=.5)
  #my lengthy function
})

Is there any explanation?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: progress bar with shiny 0.11
parts:
Hmmm, that's not what I'm seeing:

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage()

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observe({
    withProgress({
      cat("Sending progress...")
      setProgress(message = "Doing stuff...")
      Sys.sleep(10)
    })
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

How much of a delay are you seeing?
